description: Reference solution (instructors and automated tests only). Steps are applied through the public API.

steps.sql: SELECT DISTINCT customer_id, first_name, last_name, lower(trim(email)) AS email, city, signup_date FROM bronze.customers WHERE email IS NOT NULL

SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date, o.store_id, i.product_id, i.quantity, i.unit_price, i.quantity * i.unit_price AS line_total FROM bronze.order_items i JOIN bronze.orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed'
SELECT s.region, sum(l.line_total) AS revenue, count(DISTINCT l.order_id) AS orders FROM silver.order_lines l JOIN bronze.stores s ON s.store_id = l.store_id GROUP BY s.region
SELECT date_trunc('month', order_date) AS order_month, sum(line_total) AS revenue FROM silver.order_lines GROUP BY 1
